facts.fact: The ANE officially published the definitive electoral list of 2,398,158 registered voters on 23 August 2025.

slug: 2024-12-10 Central African Republic enrols citizens for first local elections in 36 years

facts.fact: A biometric voter registration exercise supplied by GenKey was ongoing, with 3,000 enrolment tablets and 1,469 registration agents deployed, per the ANE.
The exercise verifies the details of citizens registered in 2020, and the president checked whether his name was on the electoral list.

slug: 2024-10-08 Central African Republic in full biometric voter registration preparations

facts.fact: The ANE was preparing a biometric voter registration drive to revise the electoral register, with GenKey software and hardware and at least 3,000 biometric enrolment tablets received.
The ANE enrolled 567,748 voters on tablets in Aire 1 from 24 November to 24 December 2024 and centralised the data on the production server of the electoral file.

systems.platform: tablets with Centre de Traitement des Données servers
